Class ProjectContextProviderNode

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.context.AbstractContextNode<ContextProvider>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.context.ContextProviderNode
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.context.ProjectContextProviderNode
public class ProjectContextProviderNode extends ContextProviderNode
A specialized context tree node for AbstractProjectContextProvider instances.

Manages reactive updates when a project or module's granularity scope changes. Dispatches heavy token recalculations (which may invoke VCS/Git operations) to a background SwingTask to prevent blocking the Swing Event Dispatch Thread (EDT).
